title: presence_dfks Module
content_markdown: The module enables the handling of the "as-feature-event" event package (as defined by Broadsoft's Device Feature Key Synchronization protocol) by the presence module. This can be used to synchronize the status of features such as Do Not Disturb and different forwarding types between a SIP phone and a SIP server.
overview: The module enables the handling of the "as-feature-event" event package (as defined by Broadsoft's Device Feature Key Synchronization protocol) by the presence module. This can be used to synchronize the status of features such as Do Not Disturb and different forwarding types between a SIP phone and a SIP server.
how_it_works:
The module supports synchronization for the following features: Do Not Disturb, Call Forwarding Always, Call Forwarding Busy and Call Forwarding No Answer. Feature status can be changed either from the SIP phone or the OpenSIPS Server( by running an MI command).

When handling a SUBSCRIBE message without a body, the module will run a script route for each feature, that will be used to retrieve the current status of that feature. Conversely, a SUBSCRIBE with a body will trigger a script route where the updated status of a specific feature is available. This route might also be run if the feature update was triggered from OpenSIPS via MI.

Note that the module does not automatically cache or persist any feature information as this is left for the script writer to implement in the routes triggered by the module.

exported_parameters.name: get_route
exported_parameters.description: The name of the script route to be run in order to retrieve the status of a feature.

exported_parameters.name: set_route
exported_parameters.description: The name of the script route to be run when a feature status update from a SIP phone is received.

exported_mi_functions.name: presence_dfks:set_feature

parameters.name: presentity
parameters.description: the URI of the user whose feature status should be updated

parameters.name: feature
parameters.description: The name of the feature to update. Takes one of the following values: _DoNotDisturb_, _CallForwardingAlways_, _CallForwardingBusy_, _CallForwardingNoAnswer_

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: the new status of the feature: _0_ - disabled, _1_ - enabled

parameters.name: route_param
parameters.description: optional string parameter passed to the _$dfks(param)_ variable in _set_route_

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: an array of extra values that can be updated for a feature. The format of an array element is: _field_/_value_. Supported fields are: _forwardTo_ - for all forwarding types, _ringCount_ - for _CallForwardingNoAnswer_

exported_mi_functions.description:
Replaces obsolete MI command: _dfks_set_feature_.

Triggers the sending of NOTIFY messages containing a feature status update to all watchers.

_Note:_ calling this MI function also triggers the _set_route_ run. One can determine if the route is triggered by an MI function by checking the existence of the _$dfks(param)_ variable.

examples.code:
opensips-cli -x mi presence_dfks:set_feature sip:alice@10.0.0.11 CallForwardingNoAnswer 1 1 \
ringCount/4 forwardTo/sip:bob@10.0.0.11
examples.description: Sets the CallForwardingNoAnswer feature for sip:alice@10.0.0.11 to enabled with a ring count of 4 and forwarding to sip:bob@10.0.0.11.

exported_pseudo_variables.name: $dfks(assigned)
exported_pseudo_variables.description: inform the SIP phone that a feature is unassigned by setting this to 0 (the NOTIFY response will contain no XML data for the corresponding feature) By default, features are assigned.

exported_pseudo_variables.name: $dfks(notify)
exported_pseudo_variables.description: suppress the sending of the NOTIFY message by setting this to 0. By default, the NOTIFY is sent.

exported_pseudo_variables.name: $dfks(presentity)
exported_pseudo_variables.description: read-only, returns the current presentity URI.

exported_pseudo_variables.name: $dfks(feature)
exported_pseudo_variables.description: read-only, returns the current feature name.

exported_pseudo_variables.name: $dfks(status)
exported_pseudo_variables.description: read or write the feature status. A value of 1 means enabled and 0 disabled.

exported_pseudo_variables.name: $dfks(param)
exported_pseudo_variables.description: returns the parameter passed by the mi_dfks_set_feature MI function. This field will be NULL if the parameter was not specified, or if the set_route is not triggered by an MI command, but by SIP signalling.

exported_pseudo_variables.name: $dfks(value/field)
exported_pseudo_variables.description: read or write extra feature values. field can be one of: forwardTo - for all forwarding types; ringCount - for CallForwardingNoAnswer.
